mapper.select: SELECT item_id, item_code, item_name, item_type, spec, unit, standard_price, description, active, created_at, updated_at FROM item WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY item_id DESC
SELECT item_id, item_code, item_name, item_type, spec, unit, standard_price, description, active, created_at, updated_at FROM item WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND active = 1
SELECT item_id, item_code, item_name, item_type, spec, unit, standard_price, description, active, created_at, updated_at FROM item WHERE item_code = #{itemCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item ( item_code, item_name, item_type, spec, unit, standard_price, description, active ) VALUES ( #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{itemType}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{standardPrice}, #{description}, #{active} )
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET item_name = #{itemName}, item_type = #{itemType}, spec = #{spec}, unit = #{unit}, standard_price = #{standardPrice}, description = #{description}, active = #{active} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
UPDATE item SET active = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND active = 1
